title: Recipe-lab judgements v1 - one record per line in content/video_engine/effects/lab/judgements.jsonl (P65 T1)
description: A judgement is the operator's bit on ONE candidate, derived by lab_log.py from review-answers.jsonl only and never hand-typed: approve or deny, one reason from the fixed nine-item list, the instant of proof (the clip a card showed and the second inside it), who judged and when. The nine reason categories live ONLY here, in $defs.judgement.properties.reason.enum - every tool (build_review_queue.py, serve_review_queue.py, lab_log.py) imports the list from this schema rather than restating it.

candidate_id.description: the candidate this judgement is about - lab_candidates.v1 `id`; an unknown candidate is refused by name

proof.description: the instant the operator judged - a proof is a scene (E99 s60), so the clip is a beat a short could carry, never a fixture

clip.description: the clip the card showed (the path or the clip id the batch record named)

t.description: the second inside that clip the answer named, defaulting to the clip's t0 when none is named

bit.description: the operator's bit for this candidate - the choice POSTed as {item: "<card>#<candidate>", choice}

reason.description: THE fixed reason list (P65 T1, the plan's queue grammar). Short and closed on purpose: a reason the learner can carry per feature, not free text. `good` is the reason an approve carries; the other eight are why a deny landed. A note may qualify it; it may not replace it.

by.description: who judged - the answer's `by` (the operator), carried through unchanged

answer_at.description: the answer's own timestamp from review-answers.jsonl (ISO 8601) - the ordering key: a later answer for the same candidate supersedes the earlier one

note.description: the free text after the reason in the answer's note; it qualifies the reason, never replaces it

superseded.description: true on the earlier record when the same candidate was re-judged (the earlier judgement is kept, never rewritten)
